description: "Little Miss Joy" by Emma Marshall is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story unfolds in the seaside town of Great Yarmouth and centers around the intertwined lives of several characters, particularly focusing on the titular character, Little Miss Joy, and her interactions with others, including a troubled mother, Patience Harrison, and her son, Jack.
